challenge.notes: This is a population GWAS of retinal vessel traits in UK Biobank (52,798 European-ancestry participants), with replication in EPIC-Norfolk. The only COL4A1/COL4A2 variant designations are two common intronic/regional SNPs, both associated with arteriolar tortuosity. rs35131825 (COL4A2, p=2.0x10-108) appears in the main text and in Tables C, F and M. rs9559797 (COL4A2, meta-analysis p=6.76e-151) appears in Table E. Table G lists an eQTL at chr13:111054111 affecting COL4A1 and COL4A2 expression, but gives no rs ID. The paper mentions COL4A1 familial retinal arteriolar tortuosity mutations only by citation, with no specific variant designations. If these SNPs are curated at all, they should be treated as GWAS association signals with n_families=0 and no probands, not as pathogenic variants.
